# AD265 Cline coach (reference material)

This folder holds, per exercise, two references the in-workshop Cline coach
(see `../.clinerules/`) reads **on demand** — only when it reaches the
coaching stage for the exercise a participant is on:

- **`exN.diff`** — the exact code change (end result) for that exercise.
- **`exN.md`** — the exercise's step-by-step instructions (the method), synced
  from the AD265 instructions repo with images stripped.

## Where they come from — do not hand-edit

**`exN.diff`** is generated by `../.gen-coach.sh` from exercise checkpoint **tags**
in this repo (the single source of truth):

```
base          # starter state participants clone (= main)
ex2-solution  # state after exercise 2
ex3-solution
ex4-solution
```

(Exercise 1 has no code change, so it has no checkpoint and no diff.)

To regenerate after changing the solution code + tags, run from the repo root:

```
./.gen-coach.sh
```

**`exN.md`** is generated by `../.gen-readmes.sh` from the exercise READMEs in the
AD265 instructions repo (the "2026TechEd" repo — the source of truth for the
steps). Images are stripped; the coach only needs the text. To refresh after the
instructions change:

```
./.gen-readmes.sh /path/to/2026TechEd
```

Both are **generated** — never hand-edit `exN.diff` / `exN.md`. Change the source
(solution code + tags, or the instructions README) and re-run the matching
generator. The per-exercise summary and caveats live in `../.clinerules/20-index.md`.

> Note: `exN.diff` is a **coaching reference**, not something to `git apply` into a
> working copy.
